thread:
marco-sales: Heads-up — Acme wants a POC with hosted API, ~50M tokens/week estimate. Asking for a temporary per-token rate of $0.0015 for 6 weeks instead of standard $0.003. Also asking to waive the $5k min charge for the POC. Any objections?

olivia-accounts: Can you paste their expected token shape? streaming chat or single-shot? We need to model cost.

marco-sales: Mostly chat-style with 1-2 prompt turns, average 350 tokens/request. Peak concurrency unknown. Estimate 200k reqs/week -> ~70M tokens (safe upper bound). I'll confirm.

jason-deal-desk: For hosted usage we usually do tiering, but temporary promo rates ok if CS vouches and finance signs the SKU. Need approval from @olivia-accounts + finance.

emily-csm: I did the onboarding call yesterday. They want low-friction POC and will sign up quickly if latency/costs are acceptable. They won't commit to a monthly min beyond the POC.

vishnu-eng: From infra side, we can route them to a lower-cost model variant for POC (same family) to reduce token cost ~20%. But latency SLO might change. Need their agreement.

marco-sales: Proposal: approve temporary per-token override of $0.0016 for 6 weeks, no min charge, with clause: if sustained >75M tokens/month we re-evaluate and may require a short commit or revert to standard rates. Also engineer-approved fallback model.

jason-deal-desk: Sounds reasonable. Need PRD: 1) explicit start/end date, 2) max cumulative cap for POC billing (suggest $30k), 3) one-time SKU for accounting. Can you draft?

marco-sales: Drafted quick terms:
- Period: 2026-04-05 — 2026-05-17 (6 weeks)
- Rate: $0.0016/token for POC traffic only
- Cap: $30,000 total during POC
- No minimum charge for POC period
- If traffic >75M tokens/month, Redwood may pause special rate and notify customer 72h prior

olivia-accounts: Need finance to create a promo SKU and route for invoicing. @billing-bot can you preflight this?

billing-bot: preflight-check: suggested sku=POC-ACME-0326, promo-rate=0.0016, cap=30000, start=1804636800, end=1805241600. No flagged accounting conflicts. :white_check_mark:

vishnu-eng: I'll add model fallback config to the route; we'll log token counts and QPS. Make sure customer keys are tagged so we can isolate metrics.

jason-deal-desk: Approve pending final signer from finance. Once @olivia-accounts confirms, I'll sign off and add to deal desk queue.

olivia-accounts: Approved. I'll create the promo SKU and invoice flow today. Marco — please send the POC scope/TO be attached to the order.

marco-sales: Will send scope + contact details in DMs. Thanks all :tada:

emily-csm: I'll set up a short post-POC checkpoint to decide next steps (commit or standard pricing).

marco-sales: closing note: if they request per-token lower than 0.0016, we route to commercial review. For now this trade-off gets POC across the line.
